scientific_integrity: The universal threshold is proved analytically from the exact SPS map. Numerical replay is corroborative only. Originality is supported by targeted statement-level comparisons but is not asserted as exhaustive literature uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the deterministic one-sample scalar quadratic, a constant SPS cap, and a constant valid strict lower-bound error. It does not classify stochastic heterogeneous sampling, varying caps, or other Polyak-type methods.
title: A loose SPS lower bound restores the scalar gradient-descent stability ceiling
